scope: Supplementary actual candidates; frozen fixtures unchanged
domain: All nondecreasing timestamp sequences length 0..4 over 0..4; windows 1,2,3 and limits 0,0.5,1,1.5,2.
oracle: Count previously accepted timestamps in the same fixed window; accept only when prospective count <= limit. Fractional limit is allowed by the literal task, which supplies no integer restriction.
